findings.summary: The page close lost its two-tone voice. On the blog home, about and article pages the close reads 'Subscribe to the newsletter': one sentence, all in the primary tone. A secondary line sits under it and wraps to two lines at 1440 ('Never more than / twice a month.'). Published 1.1.0 closed with a split two-tone statement ('New post? One email.'), rc.2 did too ('Follow along. By email.'), and so does the reference ('Built for the future. Available today.', p1-desktop-light.png). The dot field, mono label and centered form are still there, but the close is now a generic heading at display size, not the system's statement. That is worse than the published version, so it rates at least major. The spec allows it in two places. The Page close row asks for a 'two-tone statement'. Typography allows 'one or two short sentences, each one tone', so a single sentence is legally one tone. And 'never adds parts' let the agent keep the base heading copy unchanged (agent-report: 'styled as the page close: a centered large heading').
findings.promptFix: Page close / Typography: 'A page close is always exactly two short sentences in two tones: a primary lead (``) and a secondary answer, each in its own nowrap span, e.g. `Question or claim. Short answer.` Never one sentence, never the block's existing heading copied unchanged: when the block has a plain heading ("Subscribe", "Contact us", "Get started"), rewrite it into the two-sentence statement (the original wording may become the mono label above). Its secondary line under the statement, if any, fits one line at `breakpoint.lg`. Verification: every page close shows two tones in one statement, the second sentence in `color.text.secondary`.'

findings.summary: On item detail, the plate caption repeats a fact that the details list beside it shows: 'FIG 01 · 18 OZ' next to '18 oz cotton canvas', and 'FIG 04 · 100% WOOL' next to '100% merino wool'. Signature 4 says to fall back to the kind name when every attribute is already visible nearby. rc.2 did ('FIG 01 · TOTE'). The grid cards use these captions correctly, because the cards do not show those details. It is a one-word caption detail, and published 1.1.0 repeated the category on its plates, so it is not worse than published.

Billing's third section ('03 / 03 Invoices') has no one-line description under its title. The two sections above it have one, and rc.2 had 'Issued on the first of each month.' here, so the section heads are uneven.

notes: Scope: screen step, one sample per app (<app>/20261019-023228). All gates pass (eval-1.md); the smoke tests were not run for this evaluation and run at the confirm step. Palette consistency 1.0, type consistency 0.75. Compared with published 1.1.0 (carried from 1.1.0-rc.7, <app>/20261018-022713) and with 1.2.0-rc.2 critic-1.

Update goal (iterations.md, 1.2.0-rc.3), reached. On billing the saved-payment card now spans the controls column (x 672 to 1408), level with the plan cards above it and the invoices table below. On security the sessions table spans too. Only the form inputs (password fields, profile fields, the notification switches) and the profile's live preview stop at size.form, as the new rule says. The same holds at 390px. The rc.2 major is fixed.

Regressions vs published 1.1.0: finding 1 only (the page close is one tone). Still held: the 48px settings-group rhythm, ranked plan cards with 1-2-3 slabs, the mobile invoice table with two columns and status pinned, the error banner directly above the actions (checkout, profile, newsletter), the indigo focus ring over the red error border, the empty dot glyph with 'NO RESULTS', the empty-cart blueprint, chart-in at 420ms with the teal current column on a quiet stage (motion-m1, m2), the marching connector on the about pair (motion-about-m1, bp-dash 1000ms linear), the row of three captioned blueprints level, and the success state's small blueprint with a two-tone line. Store-card captions still carry a real, unshown detail ('18 OZ', '22 L', '240 GSM', 'OVEN SAFE').

Measured layout defect, commerce / repeated-drawing (desktop and mobile): false alarm. Plate kinds repeat only after all eight are used, and each repeat is a different figure (bars FIG 06 'TWILL' vs FIG 11 'ONE SIZE'; waves FIG 05 vs FIG 10; square grids FIG 04 vs FIG 09 differ on the crops home-d4/d9, d5/d10, d6/d11). Same result as rc.1 and rc.2.

Known, not re-raised (earlier minors): the article's in-body plate shares its kind with a Related card (ellipses, FIG 01.1 vs FIG 03); the project detail's mono meta repeats the h1 as a slug ('ID APOLLO-MIGRATION'); the 'Deployment throughput' title above its stage vs 'Recent activity' titled inside its card; the blueprint craft uses clean single outlines, not the reference's ribbed tiers. The danger dot on improving trends from earlier rounds is gone: the dots are now green.
Capture artifact, not penalized: the dialog backdrop is cut at y≈900 in settings state-plan-dialog-desktop-light.png.

Scores, descriptive. Reference fidelity 4: near-black and paper grounds, inverse pills, tight Inter, mono uppercase labels, split openers, hairline grids, the teal current column on a quiet stage, a centered close over dots. Cross-app 4. Hierarchy 4. Spacing 4: the settings right edge is now one x. Component states 4. Polish 4. Signature 3: all six pieces are present and built to recipe, but the page close has lost the two-tone statement that is its point.

Verdict basis: one sample, so the single major (finding 1) counts, and the spec causes it. The screen does not pass. The rc.2 major is fixed and the update's goal is reached. The fix is a wording change to the page-close rule (always two sentences in two tones, rewrite a plain heading). The design language does not change.
